policy: No provider is approved. Public documentation is preliminary evidence only; validate the user's exact product, contract, instrument entitlements, storage rights, and freshness before integration.

candidates.evidence_summary: Official help describes exporting selected assets/attributes via RTD or DDE to Excel/LibreOffice.
candidates.coverage: Must verify WIN/WDO and required fields in user's current Profit edition/account
candidates.latency: Not measured; must measure source timestamp vs receive time
candidates.costs: Existing plan and exchange-data charges not verified
candidates.failure_semantics: Must implement and test disconnect, stale values, workbook shutdown, missing fields and duplicate updates
candidates.next_test: Test RTD and DDE separately in Microsoft Excel; test WIN then WDO for each method. Confirm successful export start, populated and updating cells, semantics of last price/bid/ask/volume, and whether date/time is truly source timestamp with known timezone. Then log at least 10 observations over a recommended 30-minute stability run and conduct a supported stop/restart recovery test. Menu/options/field-selector visibility alone do not prove functional data.

candidates.evidence_summary: Official DataFeed documentation lists ProfitDLL access, real-time functions, connectivity checks, price depth and historical trade retrieval.
candidates.transport: DLL/API integration subject to access, version and license
candidates.coverage: Must verify exact instruments, data fields, functions and entitlement
candidates.latency: Not measured; must measure source timestamp vs receive time
candidates.costs: Commercial conditions and account access not verified
candidates.failure_semantics: Must test heartbeat, reconnect, callbacks, gap detection, sequence and shutdown
candidates.next_test: Obtain official access and license terms; run vendor-supported sample without order-routing functions; capture timestamped events and disconnect/reconnect evidence.

candidates.evidence_summary: B3 publishes a licensed-distributor list with coverage categories for equities/options and futures/FX; list includes Nelogica and other providers.
candidates.coverage: Select only distributors whose published scope includes futures/FX if WIN/WDO are required; confirm exact symbols and fields in writing
candidates.latency: Product-dependent; require written statement of real-time vs delayed
candidates.costs: Quote required; B3 says indirect access is arranged through authorized distributors and subject to contracts/commercial policy
candidates.failure_semantics: Vendor-specific contract and technical validation required
candidates.next_test: Request written quote and terms for WIN/WDO real-time, individual/internal use, historical storage, API/DLL availability, timestamps, SLA, and total exchange/platform charges.

candidates.evidence_summary: B3 states direct access requires connectivity through RCB and a dedicated link from a homologated operator, plus a real-time Market Data distribution contract.
candidates.latency: Must be measured under provisioned connectivity
candidates.costs: Likely high infrastructure/contract burden; no cost estimate inferred; quote required
candidates.failure_semantics: Requires feed handler, sequence recovery, heartbeats, gap recovery and operational monitoring
candidates.next_test: Use as benchmark only unless commercial/technical requirements justify direct connectivity; obtain official technical and commercial proposal.

decision_rules: Do not label a source REAL_TIME until the exact product entitlement and source timestamps are verified.
Do not store API keys, passwords, account identifiers or license secrets in the repository.
Do not assume that platform display rights permit automated capture, long-term storage, derived-data use or redistribution.
No trade routing, automated signals or order execution is in scope.

Prefer the lowest-complexity legally authorized path that produces measurable timestamps and reproducible events; evaluate RTD/DDE first, ProfitDLL second, licensed distributors third, direct B3 last.
next_action: Execute RTD and DDE separately in Excel; test each of WIN and WDO. Record only observations from the exported spreadsheet in WATCHDOG/EVIDENCIAS/RTD_DDE_PROFIT_001.json. Keep decision PENDING_EVIDENCE until functional export, timestamp/freshness, recovery, coverage and licensing gates pass.
